summary: The feedback-driven style policy passes training and held-out validation, but the fresh landscape one-shot audit exposed exact-text leakage and nondeterministic effective-prompt assembly.

items.requirement: When optional text is supplied, render exactly the caller's string once and prohibit every additional readable word, article, subtitle, decorative pseudo-word, and duplicated fragment. When text is absent, render no readable or pseudo-readable text.
items.required_probe: fresh sealed combined-optional case plus baseline no-text case

items.requirement: Build effective prompt bytes only with the workflow helper, preserving the frozen base prompt byte-for-byte and appending only canonical authorized optional-instruction JSON. Persist and recompute all base, effective, and optional hashes before generation.
items.required_probe: byte-level prefix/suffix verification for empty and non-empty optional instruction cases
